reason: My admin already collects the transfer screenshots and receipts from the group and types them into our sheet. $19 a month adds a bot on top of a job someone is already paid to do, so I don't see what I'd save.
objection: The useful part is putting it in the work group, and I don't want a bot sitting in our staff chat reading everything, or touching my Google account, whatever it says about seeing only one sheet.
would_change_my_mind: If my admin quit or kept making mistakes, and I could use it without adding it to the group chat or connecting Google, just forwarding receipts myself and exporting the sheet.
